system_prompt_style.note: AGENTS.md rules from global/project locations are also combined into the prompt (README).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
- **`list_files`**: Directory and file listing
- **`read_file`**: File content reading

context_compaction.evidence_quote: this surfaces after auto-compact, which inserts a compaction-summary system message alongside the agent's own system instructions
context_compaction.note: Auto-compact summary is the default; /truncate <N> is a manual command that drops the oldest messages. code_puppy/agents/_compaction.py and _output_limits.py exist, but their contents were not in the evidence.

observation_format.note: Inferred from file names only. The file tree also lists browser_page_snapshot.py, which may be an a11y tree; this is unverified.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Models without tool calling support show a big warning since they can't use Code Puppy's file/shell tools
tool_call_format.note: Built on Pydantic AI tool calling.

tool_count.note: Counted from the README 'Available Tools' list (11 tools). The actual default count likely also includes skill, subagent, ask_user and browser tools; this was not verified.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: - **`apply_patch`**: Codex/OpenCode-style multi-file patches (`patchText`) supporting add, update, delete, and move
edit_primitive.note: The README also lists create_file (create or overwrite), edit and replace_in_file (targeted text replacements), and delete_snippet. Codex/Responses models receive apply_patch instead of the granular tools.
